_doc: The knock banners top-centre (scripts/ui/knock_banner.gd): ALLY KNOCKED when a teammate goes down, KNOCK when your squad knocks a rival. Seconds, px at 1080p, fractions of the screen.
_show_s: how long a banner is on screen, pop and fade included (about 1-1.5 s, then gone)
_pop_s: the pop in: the banner shrinks from pop_scale to just under full size this fast
_punch: how far under full size the pop lands before it settles back (the small punch)
_fade_s: the last part of show_s, where the banner fades and rises away
_combo_s: a second knock of the same kind this soon after the last one shows x2 (x3 ...) instead of a fresh banner
_top_frac: where the banner's top sits, of the screen height (it drops below any toasts on show when it opens)
_back_alpha: how solid the ink slash and the name pill are, so the fight shows through (the ring, portrait and words stay solid)
_max_top_frac: the lowest its top goes for toasts (past it, it sits over them): the name pill stays above ~37%, clear of your Hunter
